restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block, compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests (Lemma TR). Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision of two distinct complete messages.

This package (v108, GordoAR) is winglock's dd91b2f6 v107 (69.3452: the chunk-counter construction of e7b17fd1 and 47804be2, the exact outer filter, the E3 solver, the margin-1.400 factor) with ONE change: the premise of H2'' is the preregistered empirical Bernstein bound 85.50133 of proof.md 13.5 taken itself, not its rounding to the next multiple of 1/16 (1369/16); PASS_BUDGET and the time bound scale with it. Construction, machine, solver, sample, memory and evidence are unchanged (proof.md 18). Co-authors: winglock, Jbenisek, Subflatus3, GordoAR, leech1996, tekkac, Th0rgal, 5kyguy.

Exact part: for every outer step and c1 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5, 7 (Theorem C); an outer step whose mask (conditions (1)_j on Y9 and (2)_j on omega = Y3 + y + w8, Section 8.3) lacks outcome j holds no trial with R = 0 and outcome j (Lemma F); the solver returns exactly the words E3.h1 whose E3 of both messages has outcome j's differences (Lemma E3; the scan of Lemma SC past the cap); a returned word gives R = 0 iff its c1 (Lemma IP) is in Q*, t != 0 and E1 has (beta*, tau_j, eps) (Lemma G). So every listed good trial of a walked outer step is found unless the budget halts the run.

Heuristic part: RUN_OUTER_STEPS = 767,186,645,459,980,621,344 = 2^69.378 outer steps of 2^21 cube members (2^90.378 walked trials) succeed with probability at least 0.39 under H1' (rate at least 104,884,563,382 * 2^-128 per valid trial, the model count 2^11 * 71,698,432 divided by 1.4, and weak dependence inside an outer step) and H2'' (the mean of the pass units X of one uniform outer step at most 85.50133). No full collision is exhibited and none was computed.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 64 registers, constants and shift distances as instruction fields, one unit per executed operation, load, store, comparison, branch and random word. Counted by the program: the walked outer step 294 (random word, its eight words, y from the member table, step CO), the filter 32 and the loop 3. The solver is charged per event (call 546, guess 199, root 5, pop 13, internal node 14, child 11, push 11, leaf 49, good word 128; dispatch 56 per passing step; scan 2^21 * 192); the program's primitive-by-primitive count of the solver equals these units plus the machine's bookkeeping (a unit register and the cap test), which Lemma U bounds by X/15; it counts step 3 at most 96 and a scan member at most 100. Under 47804be2's load-per-constant convention for the outer step and filter the total would be 2^69.8433.

Time bound for every value of the coins: the run halts when its count of pass units exceeds PASS_BUDGET = ceil(RUN_OUTER_STEPS * 8550133/100000 * 6001/6000) = 2^75.796, so the count stays below PASS_BUDGET + X_MAX (X_MAX = 447,764,408, one step's maximum) and the pass work, bookkeeping included, below 16/15 of that (Lemma U); tables once below 2^34 machine units; the final step below 2^38 units; preprocessing 2^54.20 units charged in full. T = (RUN_OUTER_STEPS * 329 + (16/15)(PASS_BUDGET + X_MAX) + 2^34)/430 + 2^38 + (116 * 2^56 + 116 * (2^52 + 2^10) + 2^50)/430 = 2^69.3449758, claimed 69.34498 (2^6934497 < T^100000 < 2^6934498 in exact integers, checked by the self-test).

The premise of H2'' was set by a preregistered sample (frozen 2026-10-09T02:46:42Z before any run): 2^35 single uniform outer steps in 32 runs, the same events and units as the program (cross-checked on 40,000 steps), mean 83.73906 pass units (after correcting the C program's charge of 2,048 per good word to 128), empirical Bernstein bound at most 85.50133 at 2^-64 with the provable per-step range 447,764,408, premise: PASS_PREMISE = 85.50133, the bound itself (v108; winglock's v107 rounded it to 1369/16 = 85.5625, the next multiple of 1/16 as its plan fixed; the bound needs no rounding). The same sample measured the pass share (0.99996 of the exact 2^-7.531997) and the E3 side of a success: 1,799 E3-good words against 1,897.0 under the model (0.948).

Preprocessing: steps 1 and 2 of the selection procedure of 47804be2 (116 solver runs at cap 2^56; the counter on each model at cap 2^52, which outputs the constants, eta, the solver's beta* = 18b0e098 and the outcomes of beta* in the class) and our development below 2^50 operations: below 2^62.95 primitive word operations (each run halts at its cap, counted as in proof.md Section 11). No sub-class, rule or ranking of betas is stored or selected. Memory below 2^44 bytes (two messages below 2^42 each, the search below 2^31). Advice 112 bytes: six constants and eta, beta* and its cube, fourteen tau and eps, the class mask and value, the part 71,698,432.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. Over the run's RUN_OUTER_STEPS independent uniform 256-bit words, let N_o be the number of listed good trials of one outer step (valid trials, t != 0, with R = 0 and an E1 outcome among the fourteen outcomes of beta* in the class, proof.md 10.1). (i) E[N_o] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = 104,884,563,382 * 2^-128, the model's conditional rate 2^11 * 71,698,432 * 2^-128 divided by 1.4 (margin 1.400) and rounded down. (ii) rho = E[N_o (N_o - 1)] / E[N_o] <= 0.0065. Under (i) and (ii), by Lemma S8, the probability that no valid trial of the run is a listed good trial is at most exp(-0.99675 * 0.495910) < 0.6099993.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 uniform in the class of eta = 830303cf (2^19 members, 19 bits of the outer step's random word), E1.c1 in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 in every trial, t solved per trial and t = 0 dropped, the seven outer words from the run's fresh 256-bit words.
heuristics.extrapolation: From an exact count under the seven-word model: the part of beta* in the class is 71,698,432 = sum over the fourteen outcomes of L_j N3_j / 2^83 (Jbenisek's counting program of proof.md Section 17 run on the class, which enumerates every outcome; our own counter gives the same fourteen rows), times 2^11 for the cube (Lemma S1), divided by 1.4. Participant evidence, untrusted by the harness: on 2^35 real outer steps of the class the E3 side of a success occurred 1,799 times against 1,897.0 under the model (0.948; 13.5); on 2^38 real counter trials the listed E1 outcome occurred 82 times against 79.5 (1.03; 13.6); Jbenisek's evidence on the sub-class (13.3): partial events within about 1%, the listed E1 outcome at 0.979 +- 0.022 in passing outer steps, and a reduced-width end-to-end run with complete messages, 251 collisions against 255.0 predicted. The joint 2^-91 event is not measured at 32 bits. For (ii) (13.7): on 2^33.58 real outer steps no step had more than two E3-good words (620 steps, 53 with two); conditioned on a success at each of the 673 words, with the words joining E1 to E3 drawn under the model (44,105,728 draws), the partner word had c1 in Q* 881,396 times and a second success never, so rho is estimated at 0 and below 0.00015 per word.
heuristics.limitations: The factor is assumed: the exact model count divided by 1.4 (GordoAR's margin, 6a600434 and 3f8e4e89, and ours in d598fe29, all plausible_not_refuted; 47804be2 and its predecessors divide by 2). RUN_OUTER_STEPS is minimal, so a real rate below 0.714 of the model's puts the success bound below 0.39. Against it: our measured E3 side is 0.948 of the model (2.2 standard errors below 1 if Poisson); in our d598fe29 a real-trial check of a different arrangement had ratio 0.82 +- 0.13. The joint rate of the E1 and E3 sides is the model's independence, not a measurement. The transfer of the single-trial law to the sampler is partly proved (Lemmas S2 to S4) and partly assumed in (i); no triangular order makes the E3 or E1 words free (13.7). For (ii) Lemma S7's cap assumed rule A and the sub-class and does not apply; the measurement of 13.7 draws the joining words under the model, so their joint law inside a real outer step remains assumed. Taken together the measured sides give 0.977 of the model with a standard error of about 0.11 (Poisson), 2.4 standard errors above 0.714. How much success mass the member with t = 0 carries is not bounded.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. For X, the pass units (proof.md 9.2: 0 for a step that fails the filter; otherwise the dispatch, the solver's events, and if the cap 2^23 is passed the scan and its words) of one outer step drawn as in step 1 of 9.1, E[X] <= PASS_PREMISE = 8550133/100000 = 85.50133 machine units; the outer steps of a run are independent draws of it. Given it, the pass units of a run exceed PASS_BUDGET = ceil(RUN_OUTER_STEPS * 8550133/100000 * 6001/6000) with probability below exp(-2,034,546) (Bernstein over the independent outer steps, X in [0, 447,764,408]). Reaching the budget halts the run with failure; the time bound charges the budget in full.
heuristics.scope: The walk of proof.md Section 9.1 over RUN_OUTER_STEPS uniform outer steps with Y4 in the class: the filter of the fourteen outcomes and, in passing steps, the solver of Section 8.4 with the cap and the scan.
heuristics.extrapolation: From a preregistered sample (proof.md 13.5): 2^35 single outer steps drawn uniformly by a seeded generator, the C program counting the same events and units as experiments/halfsearch.py (equal on 40,000 steps and three forced scans before the freeze), mean 83.73916, standard deviation 7,660.38, empirical Bernstein bound 85.50143 at 2^-64 with range 447,764,408 as the frozen analysis computed it; the frozen C program charged a good word 2,048 units instead of 128, and with that corrected (all 1,799 good words came from the solver, no stop differs) the mean is 83.73906 and the bound at most 85.50133; the premise takes the bound itself (8550133/100000). winglock's v107 plan fixed the next multiple of 1/16 (1369/16); the bound holds in the sample's own frozen analysis and needs no rounding, and the claim under 1369/16 (69.3452) is stated as a sensitivity in proof.md 11. The 32 per-run sums are printed in 13.5.
heuristics.limitations: The sample is participant-side, from a seeded generator, and covers 2^35 of 2^69.4 outer steps; the run average of the sampler is assumed to be within the bound. X has a long tail (largest 4,967,706 in the sample; no step passed the cap), which the range term of the bound covers up to the provable maximum. The pass units are charged by event counts at the itemized units of 9.2; the program's primitive-by-primitive count of the solver gives the same units on the self-test's 30 calls, a check on those calls rather than a proof for every step.
